description: Defines the MultiTouchMotionAccumulator class for tracking multi-touch input states, including nested Slot class for individual touch points, with methods for configuration, processing events, and accessing touch slot data.

classes.name: MultiTouchMotionAccumulator
classes.description: Manages multi-touch input state and processing.

classes.name: Slot
classes.description: Represents a single touch point with position, pressure, orientation, and other attributes.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the accumulator with device context, slot count, and protocol type.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes raw input events to update touch state.

methods.name: finishSync
methods.description: Finalizes the current input synchronization cycle.

methods.name: getSlotCount
methods.description: Returns the number of touch slots.

methods.name: getSlot
methods.description: Returns a reference to a specific touch slot by index.
